serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
T-that’s not my problem, I would probably get hurt or worse…
It’s not like someone would help me if I was in their place, right? Everyone for himself, it is what it is.
I’m not a bad person.{{wi}} I’m not.
I tried my best, I even tried calling for help. Yeah, I’m sure 90% of people wouldn’t even try that given that whole police premium membership fiasco.
Anyway, let’s just go home and forget about this whole matter, I’m sure that guy will survive. The human body is deceitfully resilient to physical trauma. I heard it on tv once.
